title: Remaining federation test fixtures still attest on the real 10 s window (executor delivery, listener IO, relay review r2, establish)
outcome: No federation test fixture's attestation depends on elapsed wall time. A loaded gate cannot fail any fixture with attestExpired, and the product's attestation expiry semantics are unchanged and still tested.
acceptance: For every federation test fixture that attests, a deterministic regression with a real delay longer than its attest window during the handshake is RED before and GREEN after.
There is no product timeout, budget or expiry change, and the attestation-expiry tests stay green.
The affected suites stay green, a review pair is clean, and one READY goes to Merger2.
